landing.heroTitle: Never Miss a Dose. Always Stay Connected.
landing.heroSubtitle: A calm, shared healthcare ecosystem bringing elders, caretakers, family members, and doctors together on one simple schedule.
landing.builtForElders: Specially designed for Indian elders with Hindi, Marathi & English support, large fonts, and voice reminders.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Four distinct roles, united around one proactive health goal.
landing.elderCardDesc: Big buttons, clear Hindi/Marathi labels, time-of-day slots, and audio playback. No complex menus.
landing.doctorCardDesc: Full prescription control, AI daily summaries, risk detection, and audit histories in a clinical ledger.
landing.caretakerCardDesc: Mark doses given, log clinical observations, and receive stock refill warnings.
landing.familyCardDesc: Instant alerts only when a dose is missed or taken late. Peace of mind from anywhere in the world.
landing.caretakerSync: Vitals, BP, and symptom notes sync immediately with the doctor ledger.
landing.familyAlert: Instant missed-dose alerts sent so you can call right away.
landing.indiaTitle: Designed Specifically for Everyday Life in India
landing.indiaSubtitle: Zero tech friction, respectful dignity for seniors, and actionable peace of mind.
landing.passcodeDescription: No complex account setups for elders. Connect caretakers and family with a single-use 6-digit passcode.
landing.pwaDescription: Feels like a native phone app. Instant loading, haptic buttons, and offline cached schedule view.
landing.languageDescription: Switch between languages seamlessly anytime. Clear typography with Mukta and Fraunces.
landing.ctaTitle: Give Your Loved Ones the Care They Deserve
landing.ctaDescription: Join families ensuring medication adherence with dignity.
